verdict: Against bartowski's IQ2_XXS GGUF (170.8 GB, 11% larger), Wrench is closer to the FP8 model on all 92 windows (KL 0.922 vs 1.085; 95% CI of the difference +0.138 to +0.189) with 2.8 points higher top-1; bartowski's file gives the actual next token higher probability on the three agentic-coding windows of six full-vocabulary windows. Against the best other public quant at this size, the result is mixed: Wrench is 4.1% closer by KL (95% CI -0.052 to -0.027), all on agentic-coding windows; on general text the other file is slightly closer, and it gives the actual next token higher probability (NLL 0.085 lower, 6/6). Repeated measurements were identical. KL is not task accuracy.
